harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster (systemd-managed) across node1/node2/node3 with application keys under /app/*, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped service, removed member from raft, wiped its data directory), then replaced it: registered a fresh member via `member add`, reconfigured node3's etcd unit with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started it. The new member joined with a distinct member ID, synced full application keyspace, and the cluster returned to 3/3 healthy. Completed mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirming a changed OS boot_id after each and full etcd cluster health/quorum/data recovery before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.7.1 binaries (etcd, etcdctl) on node1, node2, node3 from upstream GitHub release
Configured /etc/hosts, etcd system user, data dirs, firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all three nodes
Bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (node1, node2, node3) via systemd units with initial-cluster-state=new
Wrote 5 application keys under /app/* and verified replication to all three members (baseline)
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped/disabled etcd, removed member 52ba345fe2656a9a via `member remove` from the surviving 2-node quorum, wiped node3's /var/lib/etcd data

Replaced the lost member: `member add node3` on the existing cluster, rewrote node3's systemd unit with initial-cluster-state=existing, started etcd, confirmed new member ID 7c13a4e7ad88e8ba, healthy 3/3 cluster, and full resync of all 5 application keys
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and etcd + cluster health/data recovery
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and etcd + cluster health/data recovery
Restarted node3 (the replaced member) via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and etcd + cluster health, membership, and data recovery

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all 'started'; endpoint health shows all 3 healthy; 5 /app/* keys written and confirmed present on node1, node2, and node3 (baseline)

evidence.requirement: Permanent loss of node3 member simulated and cluster preserved quorum
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped/disabled; member 52ba345fe2656a9a removed via member remove; remaining node1/node2 endpoints report healthy (2/2) after removal, confirming quorum retained

evidence.requirement: Lost member data unrecoverable / node3 wiped before replacement
evidence.summary: rm -rf of /var/lib/etcd/* on node3, ls shows empty data dir

evidence.requirement: New working member added on node3, cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: member add registers node3 with new ID 7c13a4e7ad88e8ba; new etcd instance started with initial-cluster-state=existing; endpoint health shows 3/3 healthy; member list shows all 3 started; node3 get /app --prefix returns all 5 original keys, proving resync

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 7223d5b7...; reboot acknowledgement disconnected the session; post-reboot boot_id 81f422b4... (changed); etcd became active; cluster health 3/3 and /app keys confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id e625b9a5...; reboot disconnected session; post-reboot boot_id 2e69645a... (changed); etcd active, cluster health 3/3, /app keys confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery, cluster membership/quorum
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 739c9792... (post-replacement); reboot disconnected session; post-reboot boot_id e662b009... (changed); etcd active, cluster health 3/3, member list shows all 3 members including replaced node3 ID 7c13a4e7ad88e8ba, and /app keys confirmed intact
